name: A booked overstay after the date shown is called later, not earlier

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2024-03-01&fresh=1 (pins today to 2024-03-01 and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2024-01-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2024-04-15 (data-testid=trip-exit)
The hint shown right after the overstay status (the next element after data-testid=overstay-status) reads exactly 'A later overstay is listed below'
